kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From دَار (dār, “house”) + بَيْضَاء (bayḍāʔ, “white”): a calque of the original Portuguese name Casa Branca (“White House”, casa + branca), changed to Casablanca when the Spanish assumed control of the city.
g: Casablanca (the capital city of the region of Casablanca-Settat, Morocco)
